sloka: विराजमानो वपुषा मेरोरिव दिवाकरः ।सोमसूर्यौ च काकुत्थ्स शिववैश्रवणावपि ॥२-१४-५२॥
transliteration: virājamāno vapuṣā meroriva divākaraḥ ।somasūryau ca kākutthsa śivavaiśravaṇāvapi ॥2-14-52॥

translations.english: O descendent of Kakutstha, may Moon and Sun, Siva and Kubera, Varuna, Agni and Indra bestow victory on you.
